create_mxfp4_config: create an Mxfp4Config quantization config with optional ignored layers for MXFP4 quantization
create_gpt_oss_mxfp4_config: create a GptOssMxfp4Config that overrides quantization method for GPT-OSS checkpoints
build_mxfp4_moe_kernel: build an MXFP4 MoE kernel for fused mixture-of-experts inference with GPT-OSS weights
test_mxfp4_quant_config: test whether a layer qualifies for MXFP4 quantization via is_mxfp4_quant
run_mxfp4_moe_apply: run MXFP4 MoE forward pass via apply or apply_monolithic on a FusedMoE layer
